$comment: Surface categorization for the agent bundle. Each key is a folder name under claude-plugins/skills/. 'doc' = always-on reference, indexed into the consumer's AGENTS.md (no reliable trigger). 'skill' = explicit triggered workflow, junctioned into .claude/skills/spiderly-<name>. See docs/agent-guidance-distribution.md. Edited by hand; build-agent-bundle.mjs fails if a skill folder is missing here or an entry has no folder. Rule: a skill that declares allowed-tools or runs a command is "skill"; pure reference knowledge is "doc".
